headline: Markets closed today for Diwali-Balipratipada; Sensex and Nifty extended gains in the last trading session.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed for trading today due to an NSE holiday. It will reopen on Wednesday, 11 November.

why: Indian stock markets, including NSE and BSE, are closed today on account of Diwali-Balipratipada.
In the last trading session, Sensex and Nifty extended gains to close at their highest levels in over eight months.
Benchmark indices have surged over 6% across the past five trading sessions.
Foreign Portfolio Investors (FPIs) turned net buyers, investing Rs 53,739 crore in domestic equities in November so far.
whatHappening: Bajaj Finance announced the issuance of 5.74 crore warrants to its promoter for Rs 5,799 crore.
MRF is implementing price hikes and cost-cutting measures to handle raw material cost shocks and logistics squeezes.
GIFT Nifty rose 1% while international crude oil prices tested $90 per barrel.
US Treasury yields advanced as Federal Reserve's Waller signaled support for rate hikes.
summary: Indian stock markets are closed today for the Diwali-Balipratipada holiday. On the last trading day, Sensex and Nifty hit eight-month highs amid strong foreign inflows. Key corporate moves included Bajaj Finance's Rs 5,799 crore warrant issuance to its promoter.
